nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: C entry point at main.c L52; line 42 calls ruby_run_node(ruby_options(argc, argv)).

nodes.label: ruby_options
nodes.desc: Parses argv, builds the VM stack and returns the <main> iseq to run (eval.c L117); ruby_run_node at eval.c L330 feeds it to rb_ec_exec_node (eval.c L292).

nodes.label: process_options
nodes.desc: ruby.c L2375: option table, feature flags (--parser at ruby.c L373), then script parsing.

nodes.label: prism_script

nodes.label: parser_yylex
nodes.desc: Lexer of the legacy LALR grammar (parse.y L10488); Ripper-style introspection still rides on this file.

nodes.label: yycompile / yycompile0
nodes.desc: parse.y L7491 and L7429: drive yyparse over the token stream produced by parser_yylex and hand back an rb_ast_t.

nodes.label: rb_iseq_new_top

nodes.label: rb_iseq_compile_node
nodes.desc: compile.c L901: entry of the NODE-to-bytecode compiler.

nodes.label: iseq_compile_each0
nodes.desc: compile.c L11139: giant switch compiling every NODE type into LINK_ANCHOR instruction lists.

nodes.label: iseq_peephole_optimize
nodes.desc: compile.c L3571: cleans jump chains and dead pushes; gated by peephole_optimization at compile.c L4652.

nodes.label: pm_iseq_compile_node
nodes.desc: prism_compile.c L10685: Prism equivalent; called from pm_iseq_build (iseq.c L1212) after prepare_iseq_build (iseq.c L800, invoked at L1242).

nodes.label: rb_iseq_eval_main
nodes.desc: vm.c L3313: runs the top-level iseq; called from rb_ec_exec_node (eval.c L300).

nodes.label: vm_exec (rb_vm_exec)
nodes.desc: vm.c L2891: pushes tags, tries jit_exec then vm_exec_core (L2917), and loops exceptions through vm_exec_loop (vm.c L2932) / vm_exec_handle_exception (vm.c L2857).

nodes.label: vm_exec_core
nodes.desc: vm_exec.c L44: dispatches with direct threading on x86_64 (pc in r14, cfp in r15, L50-52) over the generated vm.inc (L94); the call-threaded variant is at L122.

nodes.label: rb_control_frame_t
nodes.desc: vm_core.h L956-967: one VM stack frame holding pc, sp, _iseq, self, ep and block_code.

nodes.label: opt_send_without_block
nodes.desc: insns.def L902: takes a CALL_DATA (ci + cc) and calls vm_sendish (L912); putobject (L350) and branchif (L1262) are its everyday siblings.

nodes.label: branchif
nodes.desc: insns.def L1262: RTEST then JUMP; also runs RUBY_VM_CHECK_INTS so signals and thread switches land between insns.

nodes.label: vm_sendish
nodes.desc: vm_insnhelper.c L6377: pops recv/argc, probes vm_search_method_fastpath (L6399) and tail-calls vm_cc_call(cc) (L6400).

nodes.label: vm_search_method
nodes.desc: vm_insnhelper.c L2397: CLASS_OF(recv), fastpath probe, returns vm_cc_cme(cc).

nodes.label: vm_search_method_fastpath
nodes.desc: vm_insnhelper.c L2383: vm_cc_hit_p (L2356) checks class match + METHOD_ENTRY_INVALIDATED; misses fall to slowpath0 (L2307), and under OPT_INLINE_METHOD_CACHE the result is written back per call site (L2317-2318).

nodes.label: vm_populate_cc
nodes.desc: vm_insnhelper.c L2097: under the VM lock resolves the cme, then vm_cc_new(klass, cme, vm_call_general, cc_type_normal) at L2151 and pushes it into the per-class CC table (vm_ccs_push, L2152).

nodes.label: vm_call_method
nodes.desc: vm_insnhelper.c L5128: enforces public/private/protected visibility (method_missing otherwise), then vm_call_method_each_type (L4989) rewrites cc->call_ to specialized handlers for ISEQ/CFUNC/ATTRSET/IVAR/BMETHOD/ZSUPER/REFINED.

nodes.label: struct rb_callcache
nodes.desc: vm_callinfo.h L292: GC-managed (imemo_callcache) record of class, cme and call handler; its immutable sibling rb_callinfo is at L79.

nodes.label: callable_method_entry_or_negative
nodes.desc: vm_method.c L2132: lock-free read of the per-class CC table (L2151-2165), else RB_VM_LOCKING + search_method (L1942) + prepare_callable_method_entry, caching even misses as negative_cme (L2183). Public wrapper rb_callable_method_entry at vm_method.c L2210; invalidation via vm_cme_invalidate (vm_method.c L315).

nodes.label: gc_start_internal
nodes.desc: gc.c L4387: Primitive behind GC.start (gc.rb L65-67); the modular-GC indirection table rb_gc_function_map_t lives at gc.c L766.

nodes.label: gc_start
nodes.desc: gc/default/default.c L9018: entry of the pluggable default GC implementation.

nodes.label: gc_marks_step
nodes.desc: gc/default/default.c L8134: incremental marking budget (step_slots at L8159); roots via rb_gc_mark_roots (L6729), objects via gc_mark_children (L6737, backed by rb_gc_mark_children gc.c L4066).

nodes.label: gc_sweep_step
nodes.desc: gc/default/default.c L5871: lazy sweeping of pages; gc_sweep (L6171) and gc_sweep_rest (L5966) drive it to completion.

nodes.label: heap_page_allocate
nodes.desc: gc/default/default.c L3003 (body allocator L2972): grows the heap in pages of fixed slots (RVALUE_SLOT_SIZE, L1041); heap_page_allocate_and_initialize at L3114.

nodes.label: rb_thread_schedule
nodes.desc: thread.c L1695: rb_thread_schedule_limits (L1676) yields once running_time_us exceeds the slice (L1682), saving machine context (L1685) and switching via thread_sched_yield / rb_ractor_thread_switch (L1686-1687).

nodes.label: rb_threadptr_execute_interrupts
nodes.desc: thread.c L2878: delivers signals, throws and GC-related interrupts at safe points; thread bodies start in thread_start_func_2 (thread.c L703).

nodes.label: rb_thread_create
nodes.desc: thread.c L1127: spawns a native thread wired to thread_start_func_2.

nodes.label: fiber_switch
nodes.desc: cont.c L2982: swaps stack contexts between fibers; rb_fiber_transfer (cont.c L3091) is the public entry, fiber_alloc (cont.c L2292) allocates from fiber pools.

nodes.label: rb_fiber_start
nodes.desc: cont.c L2793: first resume of a fiber runs its proc here.
